title: Pointwise transport of fs log charts along strict etale neighbourhoods
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $r:U\to V$ be log morphisms of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], with strict etale $a:U\to X$ and $b:V\to Y$ [def-per-strict-log-morphism]. Assume $f\circ a$ and $b\circ r$ have the same specified log composite. For each point $z\in U$, there is a compatible smooth fs chart for $f$ containing $a(z)$ if and only if there is one for $r$ containing $z$. The same equivalence holds for compatible etale charts [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale]. No surjectivity of $a$ or $b$ is assumed.

source.place: VI 1.1, p.69; VIII 3.3.4(ii), p.107; X 1.2, pp.136--139. The pointwise chart calculus of parent proof step 5, written by F3.

proof.text: For descent, concatenate a compatible chart for r with a and b. Strictness identifies both chart log structures with the restricted structures from X and Y, with compatibility fixed on sections by the common composite. The monoid map and its kernel and cokernel are unchanged. The new comparison is the old one followed by an etale map induced by b, so it retains smoothness or etaleness.

For ascent, pull back the target chart along b and the source chart along a, refining around z to obtain compatible chart points. The induced source comparison to the pulled-back old source chart is etale by cancellation of etale maps over X. Strictness fixes the transported charts. The chart comparison is an etale map followed by a scheme base change of the original comparison, so smoothness or etaleness persists. The kernel and cokernel order conditions persist under the local ring maps.

theorem strictEtale_logChart_transport
    {X Y U V : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}} (f : EtaleLogHom X Y)
    (a : EtaleLogHom U X) (b : EtaleLogHom V Y) (r : EtaleLogHom U V)
    (c : EtaleLogHom U Y) (ha : a.IsStrict) (hea : Etale a.base)
    (hb : b.IsStrict) (heb : Etale b.base)
    (haf : a.CompEq f c) (hrb : r.CompEq b c) (z : U.scheme) :
    ((∃ d : FSLogChart f, a.base z ∈ Set.range d.V.hom ∧ d.IsSmoothChart) ↔
      ∃ d : FSLogChart r, z ∈ Set.range d.V.hom ∧ d.IsSmoothChart) ∧
    ((∃ d : FSLogChart f, a.base z ∈ Set.range d.V.hom ∧ d.IsEtaleChart) ↔
      ∃ d : FSLogChart r, z ∈ Set.range d.V.hom ∧ d.IsEtaleChart)
